does: Throws an ability check or saving throw of a roll expression: reads the roller's ability score (StatsComponent abilities by index), builds the roll and throws it through unplaced::RollExpressionAgainstDifficulty.

evidence.says: reads pSVar9->Abilities at its first argument, calls 0x1410663F0 or 0x141076A30, then the roll
a concentration Constitution save passes it at +0x11883C4
